notes.title: Tower Build Queue, Sandbox
notes.content:
v0.2.0
[olist]
 Added Tower build queue. You can queue construction of towers one after the other. Imagine drawing a line on the map and queuing builds of towers along it quickly.
 Added manual pages to explain the game mechanics for the players who want to know the depths
 Sandbox - Preliminary support for Level editor. Not completely functional yet, but that's coming soon too.
[/olist]

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
* Fixed screenshake to avoid disorienting the camera location
* Remove screenshake from core steal event, to avoid errors in tower building
* Add some debugging info

notes.title: v0.1.4
notes.content:
* Added VFX for tower upgrade and reclaim operations
* Bugfixes with pause-unpause gameplay operation
* "New" indicators in UI when a tower or action is introduced first
